default.defect: anomalous structure, disrupted pattern, or foreign damaged patch

bottle.broken_large: large missing piece of glass, jagged hole at bottom or side
bottle.broken_small: small chip or crack line on the bottle surface
bottle.contamination: dark stain or liquid spot on glass surface

cable.bent_wire: a wire bent at an unnatural angle, disrupting the straight alignment
cable.cable_swap: two wires swapped in position, color pattern mismatch
cable.combined: multiple defect types, e.g., cut and missing wire together
cable.cut_inner_insulation: a cut exposing the inner layer of a wire, revealing different color
cable.cut_outer_insulation: a cut on the outer jacket of the cable, exposing inner wires
cable.missing_cable: a complete segment of cable missing, creating a gap
cable.missing_wire: one or more wires missing from the bundle
cable.poke_insulation: a small puncture or dent on the insulation surface

capsule.crack: a crack line on the capsule surface
capsule.faulty_imprint: smeared or missing text on the capsule
capsule.poke: a dent or hole in the capsule
capsule.scratch: a scratch mark on the capsule
capsule.squeeze: a deformed or squeezed capsule shape

carpet.color: a discolored stain patch on the carpet
carpet.cut: a cut line in the carpet fabric
carpet.hole: a hole in the carpet texture
carpet.metal_contamination: a small metal piece on the carpet
carpet.thread: a loose thread on the carpet surface

grid.bent: a metal bar of the grid bent or warped
grid.broken: a metal bar snapped or broken
grid.glue: a glue smear on the grid
grid.metal_contamination: a foreign metal piece stuck on the grid
grid.thread: a thread or string tangled on the grid

hazelnut.crack: a crack line on the hazelnut shell
hazelnut.cut: a cut mark on the hazelnut
hazelnut.print: dark printed text or pattern on the hazelnut

leather.color: a discolored patch on the leather
leather.cut: a cut or tear in the leather
leather.fold: a fold or crease line on the leather
leather.glue: a sticky glue spot on the leather
leather.poke: a small hole or dent in the leather

metal_nut.bent: a deformed or bent metal nut
metal_nut.color: a discolored patch on the nut surface
metal_nut.flip: the nut is flipped upside down
metal_nut.scratch: a scratch mark on the nut surface

pill.color: a discolored spot on the pill
pill.combined: multiple defect types on the pill
pill.contamination: a dark stain or foreign material on the pill
pill.crack: a crack line on the pill
pill.faulty_imprint: smeared or missing text on the pill
pill.scratch: a scratch mark on the pill

screw.manipulated_front: the front head of the screw is scratched or deformed
screw.scratch_head: a scratch on the flat head of the screw
screw.scratch_neck: a scratch or groove on the neck just below the head
screw.thread_side: a damaged or missing thread on the side of the screw
screw.thread_top: a damaged thread near the top of the screw

tile.crack: a crack line on the tile
tile.glue_strip: a glue smear on the tile
tile.gray_stroke: a gray scratch mark on the tile
tile.oil: an oil stain on the tile
tile.rough: a rough surface patch on the tile

toothbrush.defective: a missing or bent bristle, or deformed brush head

transistor.bent_lead: a metal leg bent out of normal position
transistor.cut_lead: a metal leg cut short or missing
transistor.damaged_case: a crack or break in the black plastic body
transistor.misplaced: the transistor misaligned or rotated on the board

wood.color: a discolored stain on the wood
wood.hole: a hole or void in the wood
wood.liquid: a liquid drop on the wood
wood.scratch: a scratch line on the wood

zipper.broken_teeth: missing or broken zipper teeth, creating a gap
zipper.combined: multiple defects, e.g., broken teeth and fabric damage
zipper.fabric_border: tear or fraying on the fabric border next to the zipper
zipper.fabric_interior: a hole or tear in the fabric away from the zipper
zipper.rough: a rough or uneven surface on the zipper or fabric
zipper.split_teeth: the zipper teeth are split apart, leaving an open seam
zipper.squeezed_teeth: the zipper teeth are pinched together, causing distortion
